_comment: Phase 85 Plan 07 — CONFIRMED v3 /appointment PAGE 1 (of 2) for a single in-window date. Carries ONLY the ph-staff-mapped 09:00 slot and a Spring-HATEOAS `page` envelope with totalPages=2/number=0 (has-more). The second slot lives on page 2. Drives the pagination-exhaustion (GATE-2) test: a page-1-only read would omit the page-2 slot; the sync MUST read both pages before the hard-replace so BOTH slots are stored. v3 shape: date in appointmentDate, LocalTime 'HH:mm:ss'. The test rewrites appointmentDate onto an in-window date and dispatches on the page param.
